name: HaptX Gloves G1

sources.title: HaptX Gloves G1 product page (Technical Specifications)
sources.covers: glove weight, tactile and force feedback, motion capture DoF and resolution, Airpack, battery, Wi-Fi range

note: Haptic gloves with microfluidic tactile and force feedback. Technical Specifications: "Weight ~ 1 lb / glove" (mass_g 454 is 1 lb in grams, a unit conversion of an approximate figure); tactile feedback "135 per hand", "1.5 mm max displacement", "9 psi (62 kPa) peak pressure"; force feedback "Up to 8 lbf per finger", "23ms engagement time"; motion capture "36 tracked DoF per Glove", "0.3mm rms positional resolution"; Airpack "52.5 x 26.5 x 12.3 cm", "19.5 lbs. (8.8 kg)", "3 hours typical usage"; "Wifi Range 100 ft. (30.5m)". The page says the magnetic motion capture tracks "with no perceivable latency" (no figure: latency_ms null; the 23 ms is the force feedback's engagement time). Not stated: the tracking rate, the tracked volume.

feedback.value: 135 tactile actuators per hand; up to 8 lbf per finger; 23 ms engagement time
feedback.quote: "More actuators than other gloves: 135 per hand"; "Force feedback | Up to 8 lbf per finger | 23ms engagement time"
